title: Lane's SMP Mods
description: A list of mods for a vanilla+ SMP server.
body:
Thank you for checking out my modpack! This modpack aims to add more features to Minecraft, all while keeping the game Vanilla.

This modpack includes optimization mods, a minimap, backpacks, new structures for the Overworld and Nether, and much more! 

Don't want to commit to a modpack that changes Minecraft completely? This is the modpack for you! This is a perfect modpack not only for Singleplayer, but for a SMP server.
